citation: Rasmussen et al., "Crystal structure of the beta2 adrenergic receptor-Gs protein complex", Nature 477, 549 (2011), doi:10.1038/nature10361 (author manuscript PMC3184188; PDB 3SN6)
license: PMC author manuscript (not CC); facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
topic: The crystal structure of the beta2 adrenergic receptor bound to an agonist and to the nucleotide-free Gs heterotrimer (3.2 A) shows the alpha-helical domain of Gs-alpha swung away from its Ras-like GTPase domain, by about 127 degrees. A nanobody, Nb35, had been added to make the complex crystallize.

facts.text: Nb35 binds at the interface between the Gs-beta subunit and the Ras-like domain of Gs-alpha; none of its contacts on the Ras domain are residues that touch the alpha-helical domain in the nucleotide-bound structure.
facts.locator: Structure of activated Gs; Fig. 2b, Fig. S6

facts.text: Superimposing the Ras domains of the nucleotide-bound Gs-alpha structure and of the complex leaves no overlap between Nb35 and the alpha-helical domain.
facts.locator: Structure of activated Gs; Fig. S6

facts.text: Single-particle electron microscopy of the complex in detergent, without any nanobody, shows the alpha-helical domain in variable positions.
facts.locator: Crystallization of the complex (EM analysis); Fig. 1b

facts.text: Double electron-electron resonance on a related G protein bound to light-activated rhodopsin measures distance changes of up to 20 A between the two domains.

Apyrase was used to destroy the GDP released on complex formation, since GDP or GTP analogues disrupt the high-affinity complex; deuterium exchange at the interface between the two domains increases on complex formation.
facts.locator: Crystallization of the complex; Structure of activated Gs

ask: Which account of the displaced alpha-helical domain is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: Removing the nucleotide unlocks the two domains, so the alpha-helical domain becomes mobile; the position seen in the crystal is only one of the conformations it can adopt, selected by crystal packing.
hypotheses.locator: Structure of activated Gs: the position most likely reflects one of an ensemble of conformations, stabilized by crystal packing
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: Nb35 pushed the alpha-helical domain aside, so the displacement is an artefact of the crystallization aid.
hypotheses.locator: Fig. S6: Nb35 neither contacts the helical domain nor overlaps it after superposition
hypotheses.reason: Nb35 结合在 Gbeta 与 Ras 结构域的界面，既不接触也不与螺旋结构域重叠；无纳米抗体的电镜同样看到该结构域位置可变。

hypotheses.text: The two domains stay together in solution; only the crystal lattice pulls them apart.
hypotheses.locator: Fig. 1b: EM in detergent solution already shows variable positions
hypotheses.reason: 溶液中的单颗粒电镜已经看到该结构域位置可变，并非晶体中才分开。

hypotheses.text: GDP is still bound in a closed nucleotide pocket, and the apparent displacement is a modelling error.
hypotheses.locator: Crystallization of the complex: apyrase removed the GDP, which otherwise disrupts the complex
hypotheses.reason: 制备时用 apyrase 除去了 GDP，而且 GDP 或 GTP 类似物会破坏该复合物，复合物本身就是无核苷酸状态。

scale.definition: Gs-alpha 两个结构域之间的位移（约 2 nm）
